meta.name: Fortis Unified Design System Component Contracts
meta.notes: Контракты описывают целевое поведение. frontendMapping отражает только подтверждённые по коду /Users/rr/Documents/Fortis/frontend реализации.

globalContract.density: Все интерактивные компоненты наследуют data-density: compact/default/comfortable. Default target 44px, compact минимум 40px, comfortable 52px.
globalContract.focus: Каждый keyboard-operable элемент показывает :focus-visible через semantic focus-ring; hover не заменяет focus.
globalContract.icons: Semantic icon names разрешаются через Lucide. Сама графика не входит в контракт; без обязательной иконки сохраняется текстовый label.
globalContract.states: Статус кодируется знаком/иконкой, текстом и цветом; один цвет не является единственным носителем смысла.
globalContract.tokens: Компоненты используют только semantic и component tokens из design-tokens.json, без прямых hex-значений.
globalContract.motion: Enter 200ms, exit 140ms, ease-out; prefers-reduced-motion отключает необязательные переходы и вращение.

selection.sourceOfTruth: selectedObjectId and selectedEchelonId are shared state, not independent tree/map selections.
selection.treeToMap: Selecting EchelonTreeItem updates MapCanvas selection and ContextBar without moving focus from the tree.
selection.mapToTree: Selecting a map marker updates the corresponding EchelonTreeItem and ContextBar without moving focus from the marker.
selection.inspector: ObjectInspector consumes the same selected object; it never maintains a competing selection.

saveStateMachine.optimisticBoundary: UI may enter saving immediately, but saved requires confirmed acknowledgement. Backend request and persistence API are deliberately unspecified.
saveStateMachine.dirtyRule: SaveIndicator cannot show saved while pending edits exist.
saveStateMachine.conflictRule: Normal Save is disabled until the user loads the server version or preserves local work as a separate copy.
saveStateMachine.offlineRule: Offline/local-copy is not server-saved and must be revalidated after reconnect.

720.mapCanvas: primary full-width with local toolbar overflow

overlay.trap: Tab and Shift+Tab remain inside an open modal Drawer or Modal.
overlay.escape: Escape closes a dismissible overlay; dirty Inspector blocks dismissal and announces the required save/cancel action.
overlay.restore: Closing restores focus to the invoking control or selected tree/map object.

liveRegions.deduplication: One visible state change produces one announcement; Alert, Toast and SaveIndicator must not announce identical text simultaneously.

verified: Frontend wires selectedPlacementId between EchelonObjectsList and GisBoard
partiallyVerified: Map marker and toolbar keyboard behavior
notVerified: Real React DOM focus and live-region behavior
